summary: Initial-response slowdown for chat completions after runtime+model swap impacting enterprise customer
description: Issue summary: BeaconHealth reported a consistent ~2–3s increase in time-to-first-token (initial chat response) across multiple agents after we rolled a combined runtime and model variant swap in us-east. Impact: Enterprise customer reporting degraded UX for clinician-facing chat assistant; several production workflows timing out when combined with client-side validation. Environment: prod, us-east region, requests routed to dedicated cluster pool for BeaconHealth (customer-dedicated).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use BeaconHealth account API key to issue a chat.completions request with system+user messages (~120 tokens context).
2) Observe first_token latency in traces (X-Request-Id header returned).
3) Repeat across 20 requests — median initial token latency observed at ~2.5s, previously ~400ms.
4) Switching model pin to redwood-rlhf-v2-13b@rev-202601 proved inconsistent; some backends showed normal latency while others did not.
logs: Request IDs: r-0a7c1d2e, r-0a8d3e4f, r-0a9e5f6a (attached traces in ticket thread)
Gateway logs show 200 OK from API gateway; serving-runtime logs show backend_prepare_duration spike during handshake phase.
Scheduler debug: observed short-lived queueing on worker group 'bh-enterprise-pool' concurrent with kernel selection for quantized variant.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:22 - Maya Chen (Support): Customer reports elevated first-token times after our 1.9 runtime+model rollout. Collected sample request IDs and offered initial workaround (pin older model variant).
2026-03-10 11:05 - Ethan Gupta (SRE): I can reproduce median TTFB 2.3s in us-east pointing at dedicated pool. Opening scheduler and runtime traces.
2026-03-10 13:42 - Lina Park (Customer Success, BeaconHealth): Pin to older variant reduces latency to ~420ms; however, we need guidance for production roll-forward.

2026-03-11 08:10 - Ethan Gupta (SRE): Identified correlation with kernel selection fallbacks for quantized kernels causing additional compile/compat checks. Raised PR to add cache warm paths. Asked runtime team for hotfix.

2026-03-12 07:30 - Runtime Team (via INT-412): Confirmed a new fallback path in runtime 1.9.2 that defers KV cache warm initialization until first token loop, adding ~1.5–2s. Preparing a patch to pre-initialize KV cache during session handshake.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis A: Kernel/quantization fallback causes synchronous extra work on first request leading to TTFB spike.
Hypothesis B: Scheduler burst handling for dedicated pools introduced a short-duration queue where model compilation or kernel probing occurs.

What we found: Traces show an extra 'kernel_probe' step (~1.6s) between 'session_handshake' and first_token_emit for affected worker nodes. Nodes serving BeaconHealth hit code path that probes for optimized kernels and then falls back to slower reference kernel, executing synchronous probes on the hot path.

Temporary mitigation evaluated: forcing model variant pin to non-quantized build removes the kernel_probe step and returns TTFB to expected distribution. Customer confirmed UX restored with this workaround.
Observability: Added additional tracing markers kernel_probe_start/kernel_probe_end in runtime and instrumented scheduler events for rollout correlation.
resolution: Workaround: Asked BeaconHealth to pin to redwood-rlhf-v2-13b@rev-202512 (non-quantized path) — immediate reduction in TTFB to ~350–450ms. Fix: Runtime team merged hotfix to pre-initialize kernel compatibility probes and KV warm paths during session handshake (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2897). Deployed canary to us-east nodes 2026-03-12 02:00 UTC; initial telemetry shows median first-token latency back within SLA for canary nodes. Next steps: full rollout planned 2026-03-13 with monitoring and rollback gates. Follow-up: Add a post-rollout smoke test for dedicated pools to verify kernel probe latency <200ms per session.
postmortem_action_items: Add automated canary checks for kernel_probe duration in runtime CI.
Document model-variant pinning guidance for customers when rolling quantized variants.
Add alert that triggers on median TTFB > 1s for 5m for dedicated pools (prod).
